meta: Write thank-you notes and wishes with AI that still feel sincere: AI wishes are correct but bland, and could go to anyone.

muc.title: Wishes that all sound the same
muc.text: Wishes written by AI are correct but bland. They could go to anyone, and the person forgets them right away.

muc.title: A detail only you know
muc.text: Add one real detail only you know, like the time your neighbor drove you to the doctor in the rain.

muc.title: Let AI make the frame
muc.text: Ask AI for a short frame, put your real detail in the middle, then fix how you address the person.

muc.title: Short and sincere
muc.text: Keep it to three or four sentences and drop grand phrases like "eternally grateful" so it sounds natural.

muc.title: Send it today
muc.text: Write down one real memory with the person you want to thank, ask a chatbot to write four sentences around it, and send it today.

thu: Write down one real memory with the person you want to thank, ask a chatbot to write four sentences around it, and send it today.
